environment.cpu: AMD Ryzen AI 9 HX PRO 370 w/ Radeon 890M

queries: Come scegliere un progetto importante su cui lavorare
Creare una nuova impresa e trovare i primi clienti
Collegare un assistente automatico a una chat per ricevere aggiornamenti

protocol.backend_order: CPU/GPU in even rounds, GPU/CPU in odd rounds
protocol.warmup: Each input size and modality warmed before timing; model load excluded
protocol.statistics: Median; whiskers span minimum to maximum
protocol.text_creation: Engine.encode: tokenization, inference, IPC, vector validation; prepared text input
protocol.audio_creation: VideoEngine.audio: prepared PCM, inference, IPC, vector validation
protocol.frame_creation: VideoEngine.image: prepared RGB image, inference, IPC, vector validation
protocol.video_indexing: Library.index on fresh database: audio conversion, waveform, frames, embeddings, SQLite commits; import and model load excluded
protocol.text_indexing: Archive.index on fresh database: segmentation, preparation, embeddings, SQLite commits; import and model load excluded
protocol.retrieval: Real query embedding plus actual Archive.search / Library.search; no GUI rendering
protocol.index_backend: CPU for both application backend choices; same frozen index per mode
protocol.source_clip: First 16, 32 and 64 seconds of the measured source video; stream copy.
